primary_effort: Revisit comparable early absorption and rebound anchors, then identify what the actual records can and cannot show across the curriculum.
readiness_gate: Use all three E3 sets only when actual prior training establishes that same 3 × 3 dose at the selected amplitude with control and acceptable subsequent response, and current readiness supports it. With missing full-dose evidence, use two sets of three instead. Do not use Class 9’s optional greater height or Class 10’s four-jump sequence for this comparison. Match actual preparation, shoes, surface, arm policy, amplitude, rest and entry order where known; otherwise label the conditions different or the baseline absent.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Controlled submaximal height; **20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Establish the terminal braking pattern before asking for rebounds. Use a smooth dip and arm swing, jump vertically, then let ankles, knees and hips yield together and hold 2 s. Keep pressure centered over both feet. Reduce height if the landing needs a step or the trunk folds; stop if control is not restored.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 8 low jumps**, continuous; **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Rehearse ankle-led elastic return with little hip/knee excursion before the larger multi-joint task. Stay tall, knees soft, feet under hips; rebound briskly without chasing height. Let the final landing settle. Reduce amplitude for heavy contacts or knee pumping; stop for persistent loss of rhythm.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **3 × 3 jumps = 9 landings / 6 transitions**, only if this full dose is actually qualified. Use the Class 1 recorded moderate amplitude and natural arm swing when available. **120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary comparison anchor:** revisit the original three-jump absorption/rebound task without adding height, distance or a new cue. Keep coordinated yielding, prompt reversal, no extra dip/corrective hop or collapse, and 2 s control after jump 3. If the original conditions are unknown, record today as a new observation rather than a measured improvement. Reduce amplitude or use the two-set route when needed.

explosive.name: Broad Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Modest forward distance with a brisk two-foot takeoff; **20 s between jumps; 90 s before E5.**
explosive.job: Absorb a forward component of momentum that E1/E3 do not provide. Land on two feet, bring the hips over the base and hold 2 s without shuffling. Reset by walking only after the area is clear. Shorten distance if the athlete falls forward or reaches the feet far ahead of the body.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate receiving legs, fully resetting each time. **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Accept lateral momentum on one leg while controlling the pelvis, knee and foot. Push from one leg to the other over a small distance, absorb and hold 2 s; this is a bound, not a side-step drill. Reduce distance for pelvic drop, knee collapse or a corrective hop.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 low hops per leg = 6 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Retain a small ankle-led single-leg rebound dose after the comparison anchors, with less support volume than Class 1. Keep the foot under the pelvis and knee softly aligned; settle the third hop. Lower amplitude/use qualified support or stop for rolling or lost rhythm.

replacement_routes.description: Full original E3 route: 33 landings = 23 bilateral + 10 single-leg; 17 transitions; 56 limb contacts. Two-set E3 route: 30 landings = 20 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 15 transitions, 50 limb contacts; E3 time 252 s instead of 378.

Two-set/two-jump E3 regression: 28 landings = 18 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 13 transitions, 46 limb contacts; E3 time about 250 s. Original Class 1 scores are not comparable as full-dose totals when either reduced route is used.

next_intended_job: Complete the final audit and delivery handoff for all twelve written classes. Before using the curriculum, select routes from actual readiness and record execution; no Class 13 or automatic harder block is authorized.
